title: Kit Materialization Aligns With Golden Graphql
description: Fix compose/client/lib/rs so kit materialization matches compose/client/schema/graphql/schema.golden.graphql (Workspace.kit, Checkpoint.kit, TheKit, materialization replay). Run rs tests.
summary: Aligned Checkpoint.kit and KitReadPointInput checkpoint reads with golden GraphQL: added Graph::materialized_kit_for_checkpoint_id so the wip parent checkpoint (and alternative tip checkpoints) expose the same replayed kit as TheKit.kit / Alternative.kit; historical checkpoints still resolve to initialKit until checkpoint-scoped changes exist. Extended kit_store_bundle_serialize_hydrate_round_trip_via_graphql assertions. cargo test in compose/client/lib/rs: 40 passed.
